_doc: The endgames: ways to win (all conditions of a path met) and the defeat. A condition counts something against all of it (count: vassals | allies | techs, text [key, 'n', 'of']) or needs a building (built: structure id). text: the event, opening: the first line of the offline saga. See docs/CONFIG.md.

conquest.title: Victory by Conquest
conquest.desc: Every neighbouring clan bends the knee.
conquest.text: The last of the neighbouring chiefs has laid down their weapons at our fire. From the ford to the far hills, the clans pay us tribute.
conquest.opening: Hear how the tribe of the bonfire became lords of the river.

unity.title: Victory by Unity
unity.desc: The clans of the river become one people.

conds.text: A Council Ring where the chiefs can meet

unity.text: In the Council Ring the chiefs of every clan sit together and share one fire. Where there were three peoples, there is now one.
unity.opening: Hear how the clans of the river learned to sit at one fire.

wisdom.title: Victory by Wisdom
wisdom.desc: All that can be known, carved in stone.
wisdom.text: Beneath the Grand Altar the elders recite all that our people know - fire, stone, bronze and the law. Nothing will be forgotten.
wisdom.opening: Hear how the tribe of the bonfire came to know all that can be known.

defeat.title: The Fire Goes Out
defeat.text: The last of our people has fallen. The bonfire burns down to ash.
defeat.opening: Hear how the last fire of our tribe went out.
defeat.closing: After %d days, no one was left to tend the fire. Only the wind remembers us.

closing: After %d days, our people still stand, and their tale is told at every fire.

restart.label: Begin anew
restart.result: A new tribe gathers around a new fire.
